summary: Public comparison mode is persisted as paid/public; dashboard-derived rows, summaries, facets, errors, and disabled-station behavior must remain mode-specific. REFRESH_PREFLIGHT requires enabled page stations and REFRESH_ALL requires a one-use confirmation.

The service worker owns prepared station loading, dashboard rebuilds, comparison-mode persistence, REFRESH_PREFLIGHT, REFRESH_ALL, REFRESH_STATION, refresh progress, and snapshot writes; grouped scope must be computed here and reused by preflight and execution.
Refresh confirmation signatures and preflight assertions are centralized here; add normalized comparisonMode to the signature while preserving safe default behavior for existing low-level callers.

Dashboard state already tracks comparisonMode and refresh preflight/progress; update mode labels, station counts, empty-group behavior, mode-switch invalidation, and completion rendering without changing comparison filtering.
Popup has its own refresh preflight/progress presentation and must consume the same group metadata as the dashboard while retaining the existing single-station path.

The scheduler consumes the station collection supplied by its caller and applies existing enabled/stationId rules; grouped filtering belongs at the service-worker boundary rather than in the scheduler.
